summary: Arcos Dorados Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its 2026 Investor Day, where Executive Chairman Woods Staton and CEO Luis Raganato will present long-term strategy and a financial framework. Management targets mid- to high-single-digit annual total revenue growth and high-single- to low-double-digit annual Adjusted EBITDA growth, with 550 to 600 restaurant openings and $1.3 to $1.5 billion of capital expenditure planned for 2027 through 2030. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a routine investor-relations event, not a special situation. Watch execution against these multi-year targets rather than deal terms.
